The Luggie portable mobility scooter is fitted with 13-inch tyres, making it perfect for adventurous outdoor use. The Standard Luggie is the world's most compact scooter, folding down to a size of H66cm x W45cm x L39.5cm.

Distinct from most other scooters, the Luggie Standard has large 6-inch front tyres and 7-inch rear tyres, allowing it to easily navigate both outdoor and indoor terrains.

With an approximate range of 11 miles, the Luggie mobility scooter weighs only 23kg, including the battery. This makes it easy to lift in and out of vehicles such as taxis, cars, wheelchair vans, and mobility vans.

approved-used-mobility-scooters.title: Approved Used Kymco K-Lite FE Auto Folding Mobility Scooter (Sapphire Blue)
approved-used-mobility-scooters.body_html:
APPROVED USED KYMCO K-LITE FE AUTO FOLDING MOBILITY SCOOTER

Kymco K-Lite FE Auto Folding Mobility Scooter is Designed with lightweight components and utilising ergonomic manual or electric folding mechanisms, they have developed one of the lightest and easiest to use scooters on the market.

Auto Remote folding mobility scooter the narrow wheelbase means it’s agile and easy to manoeuvre around both inside and outdoors, and the adjustable tiller and well-padded seat ensure that almost anyone will feel comfortable when riding.

K-lite folding scooter folds in seconds thanks to an ingenious mechanism built into the scooter frame and is done so by means of an easy to use lever on the manual mode or a remote control on the electric folding model. The fully folded scooter will fit into most car boots.

K Lite folding mobility scooter has been designed to be as manageable as possible. The seat can be removed to bring the weight of the scooter to under 50lbs, making the K-Lite FE one of the lightest folding scooters on the market today. Numerous features have been added to this model for your convenience and safety. There is an anti-rollback mechanism to ensure you are safe to start and stop on inclines and slopes, and puncture-proof tyres. There is a convenient under-seat storage bag for your personal effects and a bright Led light on the front if you are out in dark or dusky conditions.

The armrests adjust for height and width as well as folding away to make it easier to get on and off the scooter. The scooter folds using a remote-control key fob with clear controls and there are also buttons on the tiller as well. If for any reason this fails, such as a flat battery or lost remote control, there is an easy access foot pedal to manually fold your scooter. The lightweight, Lithium-ion battery weighs just over 3.5lbs and is easily removed to allow you to charge the battery away from the scooter and leave it in the car.
